projectDescription: A source-based, content-addressed package manager and build system for the stal/IX Linux distribution, emphasizing hermetic builds, static linking, and deterministic outputs.
keyFeatures: Content-addressed store at /ix/store/<hash>-<pkg> with immutable build outputs
Source-first package builds with Jinja2 template recipes
Hermetic, isolated builds with no host environment leakage
Aggressive static linking for reproducibility and minimal runtime dependencies
Realms: named, composable system environments assembled from store entries
Non-Turing-complete(ish) package definitions for deterministic builds
Supports C/C++, Rust/Cargo, Go modules, and Python packages
Bootstrap from near-zero: only /bin/sh and a single C file required
publicApiSurface: ix mut [realm] [package...] — modify realms and install/remove packages
ix build [package...] — build packages in an ephemeral realm
ix let [realm] [package...] — like mut but does not switch the anchor link
ix run [package...] -- command — build a realm and run a command in it
ix gc [prefix...] — garbage-collect unused store entries
ix list [realm...] — list realms or installed packages
ix purge realm... — remove anchor links for realms
ix dep package... — print ix.sh files for packages
ix tool [tool] — access auxiliary tools (listall, mkfs, pypi, reconf, regen, upver)
IX_PATH — colon-separated paths to package recipe directories
IX_EXEC_KIND — operation mode: system, local, or fake
IX_VERBOSE — show package dependencies during build
IX_DUMP_GRAPH — print build graph as JSON and exit
